title: [oct2024-tenmin-oneoff] oneOffPauseReason: characterization test for guard window boundaries and precedence
body:
Target: PeaceG03/PeaceSTOCKS

add a characterization test for oneOffPauseReason in src/oct2024-tenmin-oneoff.ts: guard window edges
- oneOffPauseReason(new Date("2026-10-13T05:14:00Z"), []) is undefined
- oneOffPauseReason(new Date("2026-10-13T05:15:00Z"), []) is "GUARD_WINDOW"
- oneOffPauseReason(new Date("2026-10-13T06:15:00Z"), []) is undefined
- oneOffPauseReason(new Date("2026-10-13T10:14:00Z"), []) is "GUARD_WINDOW"
- oneOffPauseReason(new Date("2026-10-13T09:20:00Z"), { error: "http-403" }) is "GUARD_WINDOW"
- oneOffPauseReason(new Date("2026-10-13T12:00:00Z"), [{ id: 3, status: "waiting", event: "schedule", display_title: "Scanner" }]) is "ACTIVE_SCANNER_RUN"

(Builder pre-file, TEST_CASE_EXISTING, public-test-case-existing-v4): Peace's task (source: peace). oneOffPauseReason is tested at 05:30Z and 02:00Z only; the window edges (05:14 open, 05:15 guarded, 06:15 open, 10:14 guarded), the guard window winning over a failed run check and a waiting run are untested; this pins them. Production safety: test-only: one new src/*.test.ts file only: no source edits, no fix commit. Job B grades it fix-free: the test passes on the current code and fails with the function body stubbed. The running scanner chain is unchanged. A box dry-run on PeaceSTOCKS ef9778e (Workspace main 3670cd8, live 27-rule approved list, Node 22) built exactly one candidate (public-test-case-existing-v4); a local Job B run graded it COUNTS (the new test passes on the current code and fails with oneOffPauseReason stubbed); suite 598/598 with all thirteen new tests of this batch, all 4 typechecks ok. Disjoint file: each task in this batch creates its own new test file. Expected COUNTS.)
